$comment: Design gate levels per layer and destination. off = not run; report = runs, shows on the PR, never fails it; block = fails the check. 'nightly' tests the live pages, where block means the run turns red and GitHub notifies. Copy and imagery are never checked: they belong to authoring. Rules (test/design-gate.test.js): main is never looser than develop; a layer or page moves up only after 3 green runs in a row, or, for visual and visual-figma, once its baseline is approved. Change levels only in a reviewed PR. See .claude/skills/design-compliance/SKILL.md.

tokens.what: Tokens in sync with Figma (Style Dictionary); literals never grow; media rules use token breakpoints and re-lay-out the real grid

fixtures.what: The frozen fixture pages are unchanged, so every difference comes from code

responsive.what: No sideways scroll, clipped text or stretched images; 24px tap targets; every page type at 390/768/1440

a11y.what: axe-core WCAG 2.2 A/AA on rendered pages (contrast, target size, focus, names); waived token pairs only

specs.what: Measured block layout and style match the values taken from each block's Figma node

coverage.what: Every block and page type has a Figma source, or a recorded reason

visual.what: Applitools Layout match (copy and imagery ignored) at 390/768/1440, baselines per branch, reviewed in the Applitools dashboard

visual-figma.what: Screenshot against the approved Figma frame export
